summary: Independent full audit of candidate-3: all 269 Chinese source units, 258 temporal/hint or reception checks, and 116 people were reviewed. Emperor Jing’s Jidong division remains a conservative BCE 157–141 reign-era interval. Eight monuments, shrines, tombs, and later allusions are separately classified as reception rather than life activity; eleven quoted-work/commentary records are retrospective citations rather than borrowed author chronologies. No temporal geometry, omitted life-date, active-hint, or reception-ownership defect remains.
